excludeArchivesDesc.message: Leaves All Mail ([Gmail]/All Mail) out of the label search.

excludeArchivesWarning.message: When turned off, All Mail is searched every time you open a message, which can make Thunderbird slow or freeze briefly.

excludeJunkDesc.message: Leaves the Spam folder out of the label search.

excludeTrashDesc.message: Leaves the Trash folder out of the label search.

labelCacheMinutesDesc.message: How long labels, once found, are shown without searching again. $MIN$–$MAX$ minutes, default $DEFAULT$.

labelCacheMinutesError.message: Enter a whole number from $MIN$ to $MAX$. (Not saved)
